It represents a woman who has risen above societal and personal challenges and has achieved greatness in her life. In the English culture, the name carries a similar meaning but may be perceived as more of a cutting-edge or unique name.

It symbolizes her dedication to her faith and her striving to reach the highest levels of spiritual awareness and connection with Allah.
